scope: Standard OBD read-only DTC acquisition semantics for AutoPulse Check Core

sources.name: ELM327 OBD to RS232 Interpreter Datasheet
sources.role: Primary implementation-facing evidence for Mode 03 request/response examples, MIL/count behavior, DTC byte-pair decoding, ISO15765 CAN count-byte difference, multi-ECU/header behavior, NO DATA semantics, and Mode 04 side effects.
Current PID-shaped frame parsing behavior used to identify the Mode03/07/0A parser-shape hazard.
Current DTC-pair decoder and 43/47/4A response-service handling.

normative_boundary.note: The ELM327 datasheet is authoritative for ELM behavior and examples but is not itself SAE J1979/ISO 15031-5. Runtime parser promotion still requires fixture-backed validation and must not claim broader normative completeness than the sources support.
